_comment: Project-wide Claude Code permission baseline (checked in) — every session AND background subagent on this repo inherits allow/deny (confirmed: sub-agents inherit the parent's rules). Personal extras go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored). Scope: build/test/git/gh, common read-only pipe helpers, pinned Godot + ComfyUI + Ollama local tooling, docs-research web domains. IMPORTANT for agents: NEVER cd-prefix commands (a compound is permission-checked per-subcommand, and `cd <path>` is a Read-path check) — use `git -C <abs>`, `gh --repo`, absolute paths, and the Monitor tool instead of `for`/`sleep` poll loops. deny block below is the hard destructive-op boundary (no rm/del, no non-localhost curl). 2026-08-02: added the automation GLUE an unattended run needs — jq/comm/diff/tee/xargs/basename/dirname/date/stat/touch/mv, true/false, the Windows-path form of the Godot binary (the /c/Tools form did not cover `C:/Tools/...`), and the PowerShell verbs the art/receipt scripts use. Deployment itself (git/gh/dotnet/godot) was already allowed; overnight runs were stalling on the helpers around it, not on the deploy. The rm/del deny is deliberate and was NOT relaxed — agents that need scratch cleanup should write to $CLAUDE_JOB_DIR/tmp or leave the file and say so.
